sections.h2: 1. Watch the Extended Black Friday sale
parts: Redcat's own sale page says its Extended Black Friday Sale runs from Monday, November 16 through the end of Cyber Monday, November 30, 2026. The page doesn't list the deals ahead of time. If you're buying in late November, compare the sale price with the regular price minus 5% and keep whichever total is lower at checkout.

figure.alt: The Redcat SixtyFour 1/10 hopping lowrider in its three Classic 64 color schemes

parts: Redcat Rewards is free and open to US customers only. You get 250 points for signing up and 5 points per $1 spent, rising to 7 points after $1,000 and 10 points after $3,000 in total spending. Points are worth $1 per 200 at checkout, or $5 per 1,000 as a voucher.
On the $549.99 SixtyFour, the starting rate earns about 2,750 points, close to $14 off a later order. On the $129.99 Ascent-18 it's about 650 points, around $3.

sections.h2: 3. Pick the scale that fits the budget
parts: The same kind of vehicle costs much less in the smaller scale. The 1/18 Ascent-18 crawler is $129.99 against $229.95 for the 1/10 Everest Gen7 Sport, and the 1/18 SixtyFour-18 lowrider is $299.99 against $549.99 for the 1/10 SixtyFour. The 1/18 models are smaller and come with a smaller battery, so read the tech specs on each product page before you choose.
For spare parts and accessories, check the Clearance section, which the store advertises at up to 90% off.
Choosing a 1/18 crawler? Our [Redcat Ascent-18 vs Ascent-18 APEX guide](saving-tips-redcat-ascent-18-vs-apex.html) compares the brushed and brushless models side by side, with prices and specs.

Shipping is calculated at checkout; we didn't see a free-shipping threshold on redcatracing.com when we checked. Checkout also offers Affirm monthly payments, which spread the cost but don't lower it.

Returns are accepted within 30 days of purchase for items that are unused, complete and in the original packaging, with a receipt or proof of purchase. Start a return by emailing Redcat's support address for an RMA. You pay the return shipping, and shipping costs aren't refunded. Exchanges are only for defective or damaged items. Vehicles carry a one-year limited warranty, and claims go through Redcat, not the hobby shop you bought from.
